hints.title: Layers of flights
hints.body: Track the cheapest cost to each city after using exactly some number of flights. The stop limit means you may relax edges at most `k + 1` times.

hints.title: Do not mix rounds
hints.body: When extending routes for the current flight count, read costs from the previous round. Updating a single array in place could let a route use more flights than allowed.

hints.title: Bellman-Ford with a round limit
hints.body: Copy the distance array, relax every flight using values from the previous copy, then replace the array. Repeat `k + 1` times and read the destination's distance.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dist[src] = 0, all other dist values = infinity
repeat k + 1 times:
    next = copy of dist
    for each flight (u, v, price):
        if dist[u] is finite:
            next[v] = min(next[v], dist[u] + price)
    dist = next
return -1 if dist[dst] is infinite else dist[dst]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete implementation.
